description: FTC-06's eight concave overhang requests (four tangent chains, selected from either side of their seams) at the census radius. Open CASCADE builds valid solids with two degree 8 x 8 fitted caps at each chain's ends; the caps are not pieces of the stripe's torus. Arris returns TangentChain. Extending the spine and cutting the exact torus passes Full but changes the volume by 1.0325316 mm^3 against Open CASCADE's 0.9953382 on the default case; that experiment is not an accepted fix (ADR-0079 step 3 amendment). Shrinking to a lip and pillar with two cusps changes Open CASCADE's verdict to invalid, so the original operand is retained. census.json records all 21 pre-admission cusp requests, including the 13 convex requests and 11 invalid oracle results, for the census test.
